R. l. c. <he>שמרו יִחוּסֵיהֶם</he> they preserved their genealogical records; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:7:1">Cant. R. to IV, 7</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:3">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> <he>הראשונים … יִיחוּסֵיהֶם וכ׳</he> as regards former generations whose genealogies were known, their names were published in connection with historical events; <he>אנו יִיחוּסֵינוּ וכ׳ …</he> but with us who do not know our records, our names are defined by those of our fathers; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:4">Yalk. Gen. 62</cite> <he>יִחוּסֵהֶן</he>, <he>יִחוּסֵנוּ</he> sing.); Yalk. Chr. 1074.
